extName.description: Name of the extension. Working name; the product will be renamed before release.

extDescription.message: Arc-style Spaces and a vertical sidebar for Chrome, synced through your Chrome bookmarks.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown on the extensions page and in the Chrome Web Store.

actionTitle.description: Tooltip of the extension's toolbar icon, which opens the sidebar in Chrome's side panel.

homeSpaceName.description: Name of the Space created when the user has none. It is written into the user's bookmarks as a folder title.

loading.description: Shown in the sidebar while it waits for the user's Spaces.

libraryError.message: Couldn't read your Spaces from bookmarks.
libraryError.description: Shown in the sidebar when the user's Spaces can't be read from Chrome bookmarks.

notSyncingTitle.description: Heading of the notice shown when the user's Spaces are stored in bookmarks that don't sync to their account.

notSyncingBody.message: Your Spaces are saved on this device only. Turn on bookmark sync in Chrome to keep them on all your devices.
notSyncingBody.description: Body of the notice shown when the user's Spaces are stored in bookmarks that don't sync to their account.

favoritesLabel.description: Accessible label of the row of Favorites, the saved entries shown in every Space.

pinnedTabsLabel.description: Accessible label of the list of the Space's Pinned tabs and Folders.

emptySpace.message: This Space has no Pinned tabs yet.
emptySpace.description: Shown in place of the list of Pinned tabs when the Space has none.

spaceSwitcherLabel.description: Accessible label of the row of Space icons at the bottom of the sidebar.

toggleSidebarModeCommand.message: Switch the sidebar between Auto-hide and Docked
toggleSidebarModeCommand.description: Description of the keyboard shortcut, shown in Chrome's extension shortcut settings. Auto-hide: the sidebar slides over the page from the window's edge. Docked: the sidebar stays open in Chrome's side panel.

settingsLabel.description: Heading that opens the sidebar's settings.

autoHideLabel.description: Label of the switch that turns on Auto-hide, the sidebar mode where the sidebar stays hidden until the mouse reaches the window's edge.

autoHideHint.message: Hide the sidebar until the mouse reaches the edge of the window. Chrome asks for access to all websites, because the sidebar appears on top of them.
autoHideHint.description: Explains the Auto-hide switch and why turning it on asks for access to all websites.

autoHideDeclined.message: Auto-hide needs access to websites, so the sidebar stays Docked in Chrome's side panel.
autoHideDeclined.description: Shown after the user declines access to all websites when turning on Auto-hide. Docked: the sidebar stays open in Chrome's side panel.

autoHideFrameTitle.description: Accessible title of the frame that shows the sidebar over a web page in Auto-hide mode.
